name: Natsuiro no Apron
source:
Main character lives with his elder sister who does all the housework. But as summer vacations start, sister goes abroad. Hero has never washed or cleaned anything, so soon he finds himself in a pinch. He decides to bring one of his acquaintance girls to the house so that she does all the washing and cleaning again!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与包办所有家务的姐姐共同生活。然而，暑假开始后，姐姐去了国外。主人公从未洗过衣服或打扫房间，很快便陷入困境。于是，他决定找一位认识的女孩住进家里，让她重新负责所有洗衣和清洁工作！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
